description: Bar and Tree Map Combination Chart by Office Solution A Bar and Tree Map Combination Chart is a highly interactive and customizable visualization tool where users can manage the width and height of columns through separate variables. This chart blends bar chart functionality with the hierarchical structure of tree maps, allowing detailed data visualization and interaction. Key Features: Flip X and Y Axis: Users can easily rotate the chart from vertical to horizontal, enhancing flexibility in viewing data. Zoom Functionality: Users can zoom into specific sections of the chart for more detailed analysis. Growth Trends and Connectors: Users can add growth trends and connectors between data points on command, offering additional insights. Data Point Comparison: Users can select two data points in the chart, and via a tooltip or right-click, quickly see key statistics like sum, average, and difference between the selected points. Custom Y-Axis Ranges: Users can select and define custom ranges to display on the Y axis, tailoring the chart to their needs. Reference Lines: Reference lines can be added on demand for comparative analysis or highlighting important thresholds. Tree Map Integration: Each bar in the chart functions as a tree map, with the ability to adjust the height and width of each chart using separate variables.
